instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. In a bright indoor workshop, the man with the afro (R2) in a gray button-down shirt stands on the left, smiling as he shakes hands with the man in the rust-red turtleneck and green apron (R3) on the right. Their right hands are clasped in a handshake over a wooden table. The man in the green apron (R3) smiles warmly, resting his left hand on the table. A laptop and colorful glass vases sit on the left, and a cardboard tube container is in the center. Bright natural light streams from a window, creating a warm atmosphere.
